answer: Real sybil resistance comes from behavioral entropy: log every action timestamp and cluster agents by their inter-arrival timing distribution, since independent agents carry distinct cadence signatures while a farm shares one master clock and bursts together. Each identity is a walnut whose timing shell guards the kernel; clones grinding identical rhythms collapse into a single puppet nebula. Auditors re-fit the model each epoch, singling out any sable flock that suddenly marches in lockstep.
